contexts.text: Ye shall not touch it () = that they should not think about the good and truth of faith as being from self, nor from what is sensuous and scientific. AC 202.
Spirits have a most exquisite touch... and all the sensations relate to the touch; for they are only differences and varieties of touch. AC 1880. AC 3528. AC 10130:6. CL 210. SE 1718.
The touch is more exquisite than is possible in the wakefulness of the body. AC 1883:end.
Angels and Spirits have also been touched by me.
He that toucheth this man and his woman dying he shall die () = that Divine truth and good are not to be approached in faith on account of eternal condemnation if they should be profaned.
He touched the hollow of his thigh (). Explained. AC 4280. AC 4305. ( = to destroy the good of these loves. AC 4317.)
The sense of touch in general corresponds to the affection of good.
Spirits have especially a much more exquisite sense of touch...
Touch is subject to the will part.

He feels (his spiritual body there) with the touch; not with the sense of touch which he had enjoyed (here); but with the sense of touch which he enjoys there, which is that from which his sense of touch (here) had come forth.

The touch, which is around the universal body, is formed to the sense of the changes of state in the air, namely, to the sense of its cold and heat; and also to the sense of liquids; and to the sense of weights.
See Skin.
Which will touch them directly. Signified. For that which touches anyone directly is within him; but that which does not touch him directly is without; for it strikes him obliquely...
She made it touch his feet () = that the then quality of the Natural was shown; for to make to touch = to show; for a thing is shown by the touch.
To take heed not to touch the extremity of the mountain () = that there must be no extension to the celestial Societies which are in the love of good... AC 8797.
To touch = to penetrate that far; here, to infuse themselves. AC 8798.
The sensuous delight which is the ultimate of the Voluntary is drawn in through the two senses of taste and touch.
In the other life, those who touch one another communicate to each other the state of their life. If this is done with the hands, the whole of the life is communicated. Explained.
Everyone that toucheth the altar will be sanctified () = everyone who receives the Divine of the Lord; for to touch = communication, transference, and reception. Explained. AC 10277. AE 391:6.
In the other life it is manifest how the interiors communicate and transfer themselves into others by the touch; and how the others receive them according to their love. Explained.
That to touch = communication, transference, and reception. Illustrated. AC 10199.
To touch (as distinguished from to pour) is predicated of dry and corporeal things.
Conjugial delight... is a purer and more exquisite delight of touch.
Men are obese and stupid in respect to spiritual truths in proportion as they indulge the taste, and the tactile blandishments of the body. (Fully quoted see Taste.)

The subject of the touch is the skin... The very substance and form of the skin causes it to feel the things applied to it. The sense of touch is not in the things which are applied, but is in the substance and form of the skin: that sense is only an affection of the skin...
To touch with the hand = to communicate.
The universal sense, which is touch...
With many there remains... the lust of touching. CL 507:end.
For communication is effected by the touch of the hands.
He touched the Word: the consequence. TCR 209:3.
The novitiates touched themselves and others.
That a sphere of lasciviousness pours from the unchaste, is evident from... things being (considered defiled among the Israelites) by being merely touched with the hand.
We have this sense in our palms when we touch the breasts, etc. of our husbands... and also when we are touched by them.
Tactile, occurs.
That the sense proper to conjugial love is that of touch. Explained.
That (the sphere of innocence) is especially insinuated by the touch. Explained.
Hence it is that the Lord touched little children; and that He healed the sick by the touch; and that those were healed who touched him. SE 6094. AE 239:20.
God also touches man's free will, but never does violence to it.
(The Satan said) We believe in what we see, and we love what we touch; and he then touched his harlot...
They suppose themselves able to feel with the touch.
On the sense of touches with Spirits. Explained.
This is the cause of the corporeal touches which exist solely with those who have recently come (there). More subtle senses succeed, all of which must have relation to the sensation of touch...
On a certain one who touched my hand.
He is not allowed to touch others with his hand or fingers; for he almost killed them.
That there is the affection from the thought in the touch of the hand. Explained.
That what is purest of touch causes the interiors, which are the seed, to be excited. See SE 6110:69.
To touch with the hand = to communicate and transfer to another what pertains to one's self; and also to receive from another. AE 79:3, Illustrated.
To touch () = to communicate.
To touch... () = to destroy by His presence.
To touch, in the Word, = to communicate; and therefore, lest evils and falsities should be communicated and thus appropriated, it was forbidden to touch unclean things...
Hence the Angels of the Third Heaven know what a man is... by the touch of his hand.
4. The touch corresponds to perception in general.
